text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Speak to the people of Israel and say to them: These are the appointed festivals of the Lord that you shall proclaim as holy convocations, my appointed festivals.
text_cn: “你告诉以色列子民说：以下是我的节日，是你们应召集圣会的上主的节日。

text_en: Six days shall work be done; but the seventh day is a sabbath of complete rest, a holy convocation; you shall do no work: it is a sabbath to the Lord throughout your settlements.
text_cn: 六天工作，但第七天，应是完全休息的安息日，应召集圣会，任何工作都不可做；在你们任何住处，这日是应为上主守的安息日。

text_en: These are the appointed festivals of the Lord , the holy convocations, which you shall celebrate at the time appointed for them.
text_cn: 以下是上主的节日，你们应依照时期召集圣会：

text_en: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, at twilight, there shall be a passover offering to the Lord ,
text_cn: 正月十四日傍晚，应为上主守逾越节。

text_en: and on the fifteenth day of the same month is the festival of unleavened bread to the Lord ; seven days you shall eat unleavened bread.
text_cn: 这月十五日，应为上主守无酵节，七天之内，应吃无酵饼。

text_en: On the first day you shall have a holy convocation; you shall not work at your occupations.
text_cn: 第一日，应召集圣会，任何劳工都不可做；

text_en: For seven days you shall present the Lord ’s offerings by fire; on the seventh day there shall be a holy convocation: you shall not work at your occupations.
text_cn: 七天内，应给上主奉献火祭；到第七日，应召集圣会，任何劳工都不可做。”

text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Speak to the people of Israel and say to them: When you enter the land that I am giving you and you reap its harvest, you shall bring the sheaf of the first fruits of your harvest to the priest.
text_cn: “你告诉以色列子民说：几时你们进入了我赐给你们的地方，在那里一有收获，应把你们收获的第一束交给司祭。

text_en: He shall raise the sheaf before the Lord , that you may find acceptance; on the day after the sabbath the priest shall raise it.
text_cn: 司祭应拿这一束行摇礼，献于上主面前，好为你们获得悦纳；司祭应在安息日的次日行摇礼。

text_en: On the day when you raise the sheaf, you shall offer a lamb a year old, without blemish, as a burnt offering to the Lord .
text_cn: 在你们拿这一束行摇礼的那一天，还应给上主献一只一岁无瑕的公羔羊，作全燔祭；

text_en: And the grain offering with it shall be two-tenths of an ephah of choice flour mixed with oil, an offering by fire of pleasing odor to the Lord ; and the drink offering with it shall be of wine, one-fourth of a hin.
text_cn: 同献的素祭，应是十分之二‘厄法’油调的细面，作为中悦上主馨香的火祭；再加四分之一‘辛’酒，作为奠祭。

text_en: You shall eat no bread or parched grain or fresh ears until that very day, until you have brought the offering of your God: it is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your settlements.
text_cn: 直到那一天，即直到你们给你们的天主奉献祭品的一天，你们不可吃新麦做的饼，烤的或新鲜的麦穗：这为你们世世代代，在任何住处，是一永久的法令。

text_en: And from the day after the sabbath, from the day on which you bring the sheaf of the elevation offering, you shall count off seven weeks; they shall be complete.
text_cn: 从你们献麦束行摇礼的安息日的次日起，应计算整个七星期，

text_en: You shall count until the day after the seventh sabbath, fifty days; then you shall present an offering of new grain to the Lord .
text_cn: 即直到第七个安息日后的次日，共计五十天，那天应给上主奉献荐新的素祭。

text_en: You shall bring from your settlements two loaves of bread as an elevation offering, each made of two-tenths of an ephah; they shall be of choice flour, baked with leaven, as first fruits to the Lord .
text_cn: 由你们的住处带来两个行摇礼的饼，每个用十分之二‘厄法’的发酵细面烤成，献与上主作初熟之祭。

text_en: You shall present with the bread seven lambs a year old without blemish, one young bull, and two rams; they shall be a burnt offering to the Lord , along with their grain offering and their drink offerings, an offering by fire of pleasing odor to the Lord .
text_cn: 饼以外，还应奉献七只一岁无瑕的公羔羊，一头公牛犊和两只公绵羊，作献与上主的全燔祭；还有同奉献的素祭和奠祭，作为中悦上主馨香的火祭；

text_en: You shall also offer one male goat for a sin offering, and two male lambs a year old as a sacrifice of well-being.
text_cn: 还应献一只公山羊作赎罪祭，两只一岁的公羔羊作和平祭。

text_en: The priest shall raise them with the bread of the first fruits as an elevation offering before the Lord , together with the two lambs; they shall be holy to the Lord for the priest.
text_cn: 司祭应拿这两只公羔羊同初熟祭的饼，在上主面前行奉献的摇礼；这是属于上主的圣物，应归于司祭。

text_en: On that same day you shall make proclamation; you shall hold a holy convocation; you shall not work at your occupations. This is a statute forever in all your settlements throughout your generations.
text_cn: 在这一日，你们应召集圣会，任何劳工也不可做：这为你们世世代代，在任何住处，是一永久的法令。

text_en: When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not reap to the very edges of your field, or gather the gleanings of your harvest; you shall leave them for the poor and for the alien: I am the Lord your God.
text_cn: 当你们收割你们地内的庄稼时，你不可割到地边；收获后剩下的穗子，不可再拾，应留给穷人和外方人：我，上主是你们的天主。”

text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Speak to the people of Israel, saying: In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall observe a day of complete rest, a holy convocation commemorated with trumpet blasts.
text_cn: “你告诉以色列子民说：七月初一，为你是完全休息的日子，应吹号角，召集圣会，

text_en: You shall not work at your occupations; and you shall present the Lord ’s offering by fire.
text_cn: 任何劳工都不可做，应给上主献一火祭。”

text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Now, the tenth day of this seventh month is the day of atonement; it shall be a holy convocation for you: you shall deny yourselves and present the Lord ’s offering by fire;
text_cn: “还有七月初十是赎罪节，是你们应召集圣会的日子，要克己苦身，并给上主奉献一火祭。

text_en: and you shall do no work during that entire day; for it is a day of atonement, to make atonement on your behalf before the Lord your God.
text_cn: 这一天，任何工作都不可做，因为是赎罪节，应在上主你们的天主面前，为你们自己行赎罪祭。

text_en: For anyone who does not practice self-denial during that entire day shall be cut off from the people.
text_cn: 这一天，凡不克己苦身的人，应由民间铲除；

text_en: And anyone who does any work during that entire day, such a one I will destroy from the midst of the people.
text_cn: 这一天凡做任何工作的人，我必由民间消灭这人；

text_en: You shall do no work: it is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your settlements.
text_cn: 任何工作不可做：这为你们世世代代，在任何住处，是一永久的法令。

text_en: It shall be to you a sabbath of complete rest, and you shall deny yourselves; on the ninth day of the month at evening, from evening to evening you shall keep your sabbath.
text_cn: 这是你们应完全休息的安息日，应克己苦身。这月初九傍晚，到次日傍晚，你们应守这安息日。”

text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Speak to the people of Israel, saying: On the fifteenth day of this seventh month, and lasting seven days, there shall be the festival of booths to the Lord .
text_cn: “你告诉以色列子民说：七月十五日是帐棚节，应为上主举行七天：

text_en: The first day shall be a holy convocation; you shall not work at your occupations.
text_cn: 第一天应召集圣会，任何劳工都不可做；

text_en: Seven days you shall present the Lord ’s offerings by fire; on the eighth day you shall observe a holy convocation and present the Lord ’s offerings by fire; it is a solemn assembly; you shall not work at your occupations.
text_cn: 七天之久，应给上主献火祭；第八日，又应召集圣会，给上主献火祭；这天是盛大集会的日子，任何劳工都不可做。

text_en: These are the appointed festivals of the Lord , which you shall celebrate as times of holy convocation, for presenting to the Lord offerings by fire—burnt offerings and grain offerings, sacrifices and drink offerings, each on its proper day—
text_cn: 以上是上主的节日，你们应召集圣会，照每日的规定应给上主献火祭、全燔祭、素祭、祭献和奠祭；

text_en: apart from the sabbaths of the Lord , and apart from your gifts, and apart from all your votive offerings, and apart from all your freewill offerings, which you give to the Lord .
text_cn: 此外，还有在上主的安息日，你们献于上主的礼品、还愿祭和自愿祭。

text_en: Now, the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have gathered in the produce of the land, you shall keep the festival of the Lord , lasting seven days; a complete rest on the first day, and a complete rest on the eighth day.
text_cn: 七月十五日，你们收了那地方的出产，应七天举行上主的节期：第一天和第八天应完全休息。

text_en: On the first day you shall take the fruit of majestic trees, branches of palm trees, boughs of leafy trees, and willows of the brook; and you shall rejoice before the Lord your God for seven days.
text_cn: 第一天，你们应拿着树木结的美果、棕榈树枝、叶密的大树枝和溪边的柳条；如此七天之久，应在上主你们的天主面前喜乐。

text_en: You shall keep it as a festival to the Lord seven days in the year; you shall keep it in the seventh month as a statute forever throughout your generations.
text_cn: 你们每年应七天之久举行这上主的节日，且应在七月举行这节日：这为你们世世代代是一永久的法令。

text_en: You shall live in booths for seven days; all that are citizens in Israel shall live in booths,
text_cn: 七天之久，你们应住在帐棚内，凡以色列公民，都应住在帐棚内，

text_en: so that your generations may know that I made the people of Israel live in booths when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.
text_cn: 好叫你们的后代知道，当我领以色列子民出离埃及国的时候，曾使他们住在帐棚内：我，上主是你们的天主。”

text_en: Thus Moses declared to the people of Israel the appointed festivals of the Lord .
text_cn: 梅瑟就这样给以色列子民宣布了上主的节日。
